card_three_bladed_scissors.name: THREE BLADED SCISSORS
card_three_bladed_scissors.rulesText: If you roll a 6, you miss and snip off -1 HP from your ally or yourself.
card_three_bladed_scissors.notes: The card is a consumable item with an attack buff and a special effect.

card_alcohol_buzzler.name: ALCOHOL BUZZLER
card_alcohol_buzzler.rulesText: This device heals/adds +1 HP to entity at the end of each combat turn. HP can be boosted beyond base HP. Original HP resets after end of combat.
card_alcohol_buzzler.notes: The HP buff is based on the description stating it adds HP. The attack buff is explicitly stated as none.

card_autonomous_apple.name: AUTONOMOUS APPLE
card_autonomous_apple.rulesText: This item heals one of your entities by +3 HP. You can play this card even if it is not equipped by the current entity in combat or it's not your turn.
card_autonomous_apple.notes: The card is consumable and provides a specific HP buff.

card_auto_irl_doomscroller.name: AUTO-IRL DOOMSCROLLER
card_auto_irl_doomscroller.rulesText: At the end of your attack turn, roll a 3 or below. If you hit, an enemy entity gets distracted and forgets to attack on their turn.
card_auto_irl_doomscroller.notes: The attack buff is negative, indicating a reduction in attack from the entity. The HP buff adds to the entity's HP.

card_average_polycule.name: AVERAGE POLYCULE
card_average_polycule.rulesText: If an enemy rolls a 6 when attacking this entity, they reveal one member of the polycule who is straight, killing this entity instantly.
card_average_polycule.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the pips shown in the respective boxes.

card_baby_s_first_howitzer.name: BABY'S FIRST HOWITZER
card_baby_s_first_howitzer.rulesText: If the entity wielding this weapon is killed, the killer can use it for a free extra attack before discarding it.
card_baby_s_first_howitzer.notes: The HP buff indicates a negative effect, which is unusual but noted as -1.

card_baby_s_first_mech.name: BABY'S FIRST MECH
card_baby_s_first_mech.rulesText: You roll three attack dice instead of one. Each die that hits removes -1 HP from an enemy. You can target multiple enemies at once.
card_baby_s_first_mech.notes: The attack buff is based on rolling three dice, and the HP buff is from the Uranium Armor. No specific HP or attack values are defined for the item itself.

card_electric_bathtub.name: Electric Bathtub
card_electric_bathtub.rulesText: Invite an enemy to take a bath. Roll a 4 or below. If you hit, both you and your enemy are killed by evil electrons. If you miss, you don't take a bath.
card_electric_bathtub.notes: The card is consumable and does not have its own HP or attack values.

card_billy_s_big_castle.name: BILLY'S BIG CASTLE
card_billy_s_big_castle.rulesText: Before your attacker's first attack, roll a 3 or below. If you hit, all enemies lose 1 HP from boiling oil.
card_billy_s_big_castle.notes: The fortress has a total of 12 HP from the four dice showing 3 pips each. The attack buff is not present, and the HP buff indicates a loss of 1 HP for enemies.

card_build_it_yourself_brick.name: BUILD-IT-YOURSELF BRICK
card_build_it_yourself_brick.rulesText: Draw cards from your deck until you get 3 equippable items. Distribute them across your team and return any unequippable cards to your deck.
card_build_it_yourself_brick.notes: The card is consumable as indicated by the text 'CONSUMABLE (DISCARD AFTER USE)'.

card_blender_of_equal_exchange.name: BLENDER OF EQUAL EXCHANGE
card_blender_of_equal_exchange.rulesText: You and your enemy hop into this blender. If you roll a 3 or below, both you and your enemy die. If you miss, your enemy only loses 1 HP and you die a gruesome death for no reason.
card_blender_of_equal_exchange.notes: The card is consumable and does not have its own HP or attack values.

card_breathable_underoos.name: BREATHABLE UNDEROOS
card_breathable_underoos.rulesText: Two of your units can wear this item at the same time and it adds 3 to entity HP.
card_breathable_underoos.notes: The card is consumable as it provides a buff and has a special effect.

card_neighborhood_brick_stand.name: NEIGHBORHOOD BRICK STAND
card_neighborhood_brick_stand.rulesText: At the beginning of each combat round, roll a 2 or below. If you hit, draw and immediately equip/use a random card from your deck. If it is an entity/fortress, return it.
card_neighborhood_brick_stand.notes: The attack buff is based on the pips shown in the attack buff box. The card does not have its own HP or attack values.

card_brat.name: BRAT
card_brat.rulesText: In combat, allies can eat this entity, allowing all to regain +2 HP. In doing so, this entity dies.
card_brat.notes: The attack value is based on the roll of 3 pips shown in the attack box.

card_call_the_bees.name: CALL THE BEES
card_call_the_bees.rulesText: Roll a 5 or below to call bees that sting your enemy for 3 HP. If you miss, you lose 2 HP.
card_call_the_bees.notes: The card is consumable and does not have its own HP or attack values.

card_billy_is_stranded.name: BILLY IS STRANDED
card_billy_is_stranded.rulesText: At the end of your attacks, roll a 3 or below. If you hit, a shark bites an enemy and they lose 2 HP.
card_billy_is_stranded.notes: The HP is calculated from the pips in the HP box. The attack and buffs are not applicable for entity cards.

card_double_sided_plunger.name: DOUBLE-SIDED PLUNGER
card_double_sided_plunger.rulesText: Roll a 5 or below to clog up your enemy fortress' sewage, forcing everyone to evacuate. The fortress becomes available for anyone to take.
card_double_sided_plunger.notes: The card is consumable and does not have a special header.

card_famous_actor.name: FAMOUS ACTOR
card_famous_actor.rulesText: Everyone loves him because he's so famous and special.

card_fish_walking_robot.name: FISH WALKING ROBOT
card_fish_walking_robot.rulesText: At the end of your attack turn, the Fish Walker heals all your surviving entities for +1 HP, without exceeding their base HP.
card_fish_walking_robot.notes: The attack buff is derived from the 'PHISHE OF DESPAIR' effect, while the HP buff is noted as 'NONE'.

card_gear_mech_suit.name: GEAR MECH SUIT
card_gear_mech_suit.rulesText: This item adds 4 to the entity's HP but subtracts 1 from its attack.
card_gear_mech_suit.notes: The card does not have a special header, and it is a regular item providing buffs.

card_glove_bot.name: GLOVE BOT
card_glove_bot.rulesText: The GLOVE BOT makes gloves for all entities in combat, adding +1 HP to all entities' max hitpoints if equipped by an entity in combat.
card_glove_bot.notes: The HP buff is based on the description stating it adds +1 HP to entities. The card is classified as consumable due to the nature of the effect.

card_gut_stabber_9002.name: GUT STABBER 9002
card_gut_stabber_9002.rulesText: Instead of attacking, you can roll a 3 or below. If you hit, you attach the Gut Stabber 9002 to your enemy, which removes -2 HP from them each combat round until removed.
card_gut_stabber_9002.notes: The attack buff is based on the text 'add +1 attack to entity'. The HP buff is explicitly stated as 'NONE'.

card_just_a_happy_guy.name: JUST A HAPPY GUY
card_just_a_happy_guy.rulesText: Don't mind his eyes. They just do that sometimes.
card_just_a_happy_guy.notes: The card does not have any special abilities or effects indicated by a special header.

card_hedgeward_cheddar.name: HEDGEWARD CHEDDAR
card_hedgeward_cheddar.rulesText: At the end of your combat turn, roll a 2 or below. If you hit, you infect all enemies with the bubonic plague, causing them to lose 2 HP.
card_hedgeward_cheddar.notes: The attack and HP values are based on the pips shown on the dice. The card has a special ability indicated by the yellow header.

card_homunculus_phage_stage.name: HOMUNCULUS: PHAGE STAGE
card_homunculus_phage_stage.rulesText: At the end of your turn, you can roll a 3 or below. If you hit, you burrow into an enemy's ear canal. You cannot attack, but after each combat round, the enemy entity automatically loses 1 HP.
card_homunculus_phage_stage.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the visible pips. The special ability is clearly indicated.

card_jimmy_two_hats.name: JIMMY TWO HATS
card_jimmy_two_hats.rulesText: Jimmy has a unique nickname related to his appearance.
card_jimmy_two_hats.notes: The attack value is not specified, so it is set to null.

card_jonathan_porkthaniel.name: JONATHAN PORKTHANIEL
card_jonathan_porkthaniel.rulesText: If an enemy rolls a 6 when attacking this entity, the game ends with no winner.
card_jonathan_porkthaniel.notes: The attack value is based on the pips shown in the attack box, and the HP is based on the pips in the HP box.

card_jit_named_beck.name: JIT NAMED BECK
card_jit_named_beck.rulesText: This entity has 2 HP and can attack with a roll of 3 or below.
card_jit_named_beck.notes: The attack value is based on the roll threshold, which is interpreted as 3.

card_lord_flumpuqat.name: LORD FLUMPUQAT
card_lord_flumpuqat.rulesText: You can pay an enemy to switch sides and attack their own team on their turn, but one of your entities must discard an equipped item to do this.
card_lord_flumpuqat.notes: The attack value is not specified, so it is set to null.

card_handheld_michael_wave.name: HANDHELD MICHAEL WAVE
card_handheld_michael_wave.rulesText: If you kill an enemy, you can eat him/her/it to recover up to +2 HP.
card_handheld_michael_wave.notes: The item has a special effect and is consumable.

card_combat_school_bus.name: COMBAT SCHOOL BUS
card_combat_school_bus.rulesText: If you defeat all attackers, roll a 2 or below. If you hit, you destroy an enemy fortress and all entities inside (enemy's choice).
card_combat_school_bus.notes: The fortress has a total of 8 HP from the pips in the HP box. The attack buff is not present, and the HP buff is 2 from the relevant dice. The special ability is indicated by the yellow header.

card_mobile_burger.name: MOBILE BURGER
card_mobile_burger.rulesText: This item heals one of your entities by +4 HP and can be played even if not equipped by an entity in combat.
card_mobile_burger.notes: The card is clearly labeled as consumable and provides a specific HP buff.

card_mister_flour.name: MISTER FLOUR
card_mister_flour.rulesText: Mister Flour can calm others with his chamomile flower. Roll a 3 or below at the end of your turn to make your enemy leave the battlefield without attacking.
card_mister_flour.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the visible pips on the dice. The special ability is indicated by the yellow header.

card_nuclear_brick.name: Nuclear Brick
card_nuclear_brick.rulesText: You can trigger a reactor meltdown by rolling a 3 or below. On hit, all entities on board die; on miss, only this fortress blows up.
card_nuclear_brick.notes: The fortress HP is calculated from the pips in the HP box (4+4=8). The attack buff and HP buff are from the respective buff boxes (2 each).

card_o_neill_cylinder.name: O'Neill Cylinder
card_o_neill_cylinder.rulesText: At the end of your turn, roll a 1. If you hit, you vaporize an enemy with your laser.
card_o_neill_cylinder.notes: The card is consumable as it has a special effect and does not provide its own HP or attack.

card_post_modern_chair.name: POST-MODERN CHAIR
card_post_modern_chair.rulesText: Sitting in this chair makes you invisible to enemies. They cannot attack your entity if you don’t want them to. Conversely, you cannot attack enemies. This does not make you immune to area affect weapons.
card_post_modern_chair.notes: The card is a consumable item as indicated by the description and the presence of a SPECIAL header.

card_pyramid_of_ill_intent.name: PYRAMID OF ILL INTENT
card_pyramid_of_ill_intent.rulesText: At the end of the combat round, roll a 3 or below. If you hit, an equipped enemy item mysteriously disappears.
card_pyramid_of_ill_intent.notes: The fortress HP is based on the pips in the HP box, and the attack buff and HP buff are based on the respective dice. The special rule is clearly indicated.

card_recon_chicken.name: RECON CHICKEN
card_recon_chicken.rulesText: Allows you to look through the enemy's hand and call a drone strike on a chosen card. If you roll a 5 or below, that card is discarded.
card_recon_chicken.notes: The card is consumable and does not have its own HP or attack values.

card_sales_skull.name: SALES SKULL
card_sales_skull.rulesText: Allows the player to draw 3 cards from the deck during combat. If a fortress is drawn, it is returned. Entities and items can be used immediately.
card_sales_skull.notes: The card is consumable and does not provide any HP or attack stats.

card_skinfished.name: SKINFISHED
card_skinfished.rulesText: When played, the first person to call the last person they went on a date with kills their enemy unit in combat.
card_skinfished.notes: The card is consumable and does not have any numeric stats.

card_lil_bug_boy.name: LIL' BUG BOY
card_lil_bug_boy.rulesText: Bimbus Bugsley can roll a 5 or below to force an enemy bug to attack one of its teammates after his attack turn.
card_lil_bug_boy.notes: The attack value is based on the dice shown, and the special ability is indicated by the yellow header.

card_smoking_machine_mk_1.name: SMOKING MACHINE MK.1
card_smoking_machine_mk_1.rulesText: At the end of each turn, roll a 5 or below. On hit, all entities lose 1 HP due to secondhand smoke.
card_smoking_machine_mk_1.notes: The HP buff indicates a negative effect on entities, which is unusual but noted as -1.

card_smuckle.name: SMUCKLE
card_smuckle.rulesText: SMUCKLE can attack by rolling a die and succeeding on a roll of 2 or below.
card_smuckle.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the visible pips in the respective boxes. The attack condition is inferred from the text.

card_snail_rider.name: SNAIL RIDER
card_snail_rider.rulesText: Entity cannot retreat because it's too slow.
card_snail_rider.notes: The HP is based on the 4 pips in the HP box. Attack is not defined, so it's null.

card_sneefus.name: SNEEFUS
card_sneefus.rulesText: SNEEFUS can slide out of combat without an enemy retreat attack, allowing free retreats.
card_sneefus.notes: The attack value is not specified on the card, so it is set to null.

card_terrance_mousethaniel.name: Terrance Mousethaniel
card_terrance_mousethaniel.rulesText: Terrance Mouse is Mickey's less famous brother, Terry. To attack, roll a 3 or below.
card_terrance_mousethaniel.notes: The attack value is based on the pips shown in the attack box, and the HP is based on the pips in the HP box.

card_meat_show.name: MEAT SHOW
card_meat_show.rulesText: Challenge your enemy to a thumb war. The winner (best 2 out of 3) instantly kills the opponent entity.
card_meat_show.notes: The card is consumable and does not provide any buffs or stats.

card_tactical_stick.name: TACTICAL STICK
card_tactical_stick.rulesText: You can pull the pin on the grenade, damaging your target by -3 HP. This item is destroyed in the process.
card_tactical_stick.notes: The HP buff is negative, indicating damage dealt to the target.

card_toe_truck.name: TOE TRUCK
card_toe_truck.rulesText: A vehicle converted from the appendage of a giant Nephilim. Entities crawl under the nail for protection.
card_toe_truck.notes: The card does not have a special header and is classified as a regular item.

card_wormson_wormley.name: Wormson Wormley
card_wormson_wormley.rulesText: Don't interfere: he's off to work, and he cannot be late!
card_wormson_wormley.notes: The attack value is not defined on the card, so it is set to null.

card_zark.name: ZARK
card_zark.rulesText: Zark has 3 HP and can attack with a bite if the roll is 3 or below.
card_zark.notes: The attack value is based on the roll threshold provided.

card_accountant_on_the_hunt_for_files_do.name: ACCOUNTANT ON THE HUNT FOR FILES & DOCUMENTS
card_accountant_on_the_hunt_for_files_do.rulesText: Summon the accountant to confiscate up to 4 items from your enemies in battle.
card_accountant_on_the_hunt_for_files_do.notes: The card is consumable and has no special header.

card_appendage_lengthening_apparatus.name: APPENDAGE LENGTHENING APPARATUS
card_appendage_lengthening_apparatus.rulesText: Add 3 HP to all your entities in this battle.
card_appendage_lengthening_apparatus.notes: The card is consumable and does not have a special header.

card_automated_book_writer.name: AUTOMATED BOOK WRITER
card_automated_book_writer.rulesText: Explain the rules of the game to a large language model A.I. and select one of five new rules it generates to play with until the end of the game.
card_automated_book_writer.notes: The card is consumable and does not have any special header.

card_felonious_tattoo_parlour.name: Felonious Tattoo Parlour
card_felonious_tattoo_parlour.rulesText: Challenge your enemy to draw the best tattoo in 60 seconds. If you lose, the entity holding this item dies; if you win, you choose a combat enemy to die.
card_felonious_tattoo_parlour.notes: The card is consumable and does not provide any HP or attack stats.

card_the_bamboo_switcharoo.name: THE BAMBOO SWITCHAROO
card_the_bamboo_switcharoo.rulesText: Sneak bamboo into your enemy's bones, causing them to take extra damage in battle.
card_the_bamboo_switcharoo.notes: The card is consumable and does not have a special header.

card_bargain_bin_surgery_bot.name: BARGAIN BIN SURGERY BOT
card_bargain_bin_surgery_bot.rulesText: Discard 7 cards from your hand to resurrect an entity that just died, bringing it back with only 1 HP.
card_bargain_bin_surgery_bot.notes: The card is a consumable item with a special ability, hence the special flag is set to true.

card_beans.name: BEANS
card_beans.notes: The card is consumable and provides a clear HP buff.

card_big_boy_hat_xtra_longe.name: BIG BOY HAT (XTRA LONGE)
card_big_boy_hat_xtra_longe.rulesText: If your enemy is also wearing a hat, on hit, you knock off their hat. Their hat goes in the discard pile.
card_big_boy_hat_xtra_longe.notes: The attack buff is based on the pips shown in the attack buff box, and the HP buff is based on the HP buff box. The special rule is clearly indicated.

card_bionicus_brunkle.name: Bionicus Brunkle
card_bionicus_brunkle.rulesText: A cyborg that escaped from a state surveillance program, it has a motivation related to cucumbers.
card_bionicus_brunkle.notes: The attack value is not defined on the card, so it is set to null.

card_bj_rknelius.name: BJÖRKNELIUS
card_bj_rknelius.rulesText: He got to choose his weapon first since he's the boss' favorite.
card_bj_rknelius.notes: The attack value is based on the roll threshold mentioned, which indicates a maximum of 5.

card_blood_strawberry.name: BLOOD STRAWBERRY
card_blood_strawberry.notes: The card is consumable and does not have a special header.

card_boomerism.name: Boomerism
card_boomerism.rulesText: You can leech off your allies! After your turn, increase your HP by decreasing your allies' by the same amount. You cannot exceed your max HP.
card_boomerism.notes: The card is consumable as it does not have its own HP or attack, and it has a special effect.

card_brick_2_0.name: BRICK 2.0
card_brick_2_0.rulesText: If your enemy rolls a 6 against you when attacking, they throw you into the discard pile for immediate death.
card_brick_2_0.notes: The attack buff is based on the roll indicated, but the card does not specify a base attack value.

card_brick_3_0.name: BRICK 3.0
card_brick_3_0.rulesText: Use this to access the Brick mainframe.
card_brick_3_0.notes: The card does not indicate any special abilities or consumable status.

card_misc_brick_parts.name: MISC. BRICK PARTS
card_misc_brick_parts.rulesText: This card allows you to exceed all fortress HP for the battle, resetting HP based on the number of HP dice rolled.
card_misc_brick_parts.notes: The card does not have its own HP or attack values, and the special rules are related to resetting HP.

card_bugcessories.name: BUGCESSORIES
card_bugcessories.rulesText: If you roll a 6 during an attack, you lose 1 HP due to a bug bite.
card_bugcessories.notes: The card does not have a special header, and it is not a consumable item.

card_cat_wit_da_gat.name: CAT WIT DA GAT
card_cat_wit_da_gat.rulesText: If the cat gets killed, roll a 2 or below. If you hit, the entity comes back to life with 1 HP.
card_cat_wit_da_gat.notes: The attack value is based on the sum of the pips in the attack box, which shows 3 pips.

card_cloud_factory.name: CLOUD FACTORY
card_cloud_factory.rulesText: This fortress produces toxic gas. You can roll a 2 or below at the beginning of your battle to hit all enemies, causing them to lose 1 HP.
card_cloud_factory.notes: The fortress HP is based on the total pips in the HP box, and the attack and HP buffs are derived from their respective boxes.

card_slow_flow_co2_laser.name: SLOW FLOW CO2 LASER
card_slow_flow_co2_laser.rulesText: This item adds 5 to the attack of an entity and subtracts 1 HP from the entity due to fragile worms.
card_slow_flow_co2_laser.notes: The attack buff and HP buff are derived from the respective dice shown. The special effect indicates a unique damage mechanic.

card_political_compass_hat.name: POLITICAL COMPASS HAT
card_political_compass_hat.rulesText: This hat analyzes your enemy's weaknesses, causing every hit to deal an additional 1 HP damage.
card_political_compass_hat.notes: The HP buff indicates a reduction of 1 HP from the entity wearing the hat.

card_corned_cream.name: CORNED CREAM
card_corned_cream.rulesText: Heals either an entity or fortress by +4 HP.
card_corned_cream.notes: The card is consumable and does not have a special header.

card_i_wish_i_could_read.name: I WISH I COULD READ
card_i_wish_i_could_read.rulesText: When played, the effect of any consumable card or special is nullified (because you can't read).
card_i_wish_i_could_read.notes: The card is a consumable item with no numeric stats.

card_goosnav_credit_union.name: GOOSNAV CREDIT UNION
card_goosnav_credit_union.rulesText: At the end of your combat turn, roll a 3 or below. If you hit, draw and deploy a card from your deck (except fortresses).
card_goosnav_credit_union.notes: The fortress has a total of 6 HP from the HP box and an attack buff of 2 from the attack buff box.

card_a_cruel_trick.name: A CRUEL TRICK
card_a_cruel_trick.rulesText: Roll a 4 or below to hit. If successful, the enemy returns to their deck and discards all equipped items. Rolling a 6 grants +1 HP.
card_a_cruel_trick.notes: The card is consumable and does not have a special header.

card_cubex.name: CUBEX
card_cubex.rulesText: At any point in the game, you can play this card to choose an enemy entity and pack it into the Cubex, returning it to the deck along with any items it was holding.
card_cubex.notes: The card is clearly labeled as consumable and does not have any special header.

card_cug.name: CUG
card_cug.rulesText: This entity has 1 HP and can attack with a roll of 2 or below.
card_cug.notes: The attack value is based on the pips shown in the attack box, which sums to 2.

card_the_curse_of_time.name: THE CURSE OF TIME
card_the_curse_of_time.rulesText: Play this at any time. Roll a 4 or below. If you hit, your enemy must discard all cards in their hand, then draw 7 new cards.
card_the_curse_of_time.notes: The card is consumable and does not have its own HP or attack values.

card_cybertoade.name: CYBERTOADE
card_cybertoade.rulesText: This card provides a significant attack and HP buff to entities, but requires painful surgery to use.
card_cybertoade.notes: The HP is calculated from the two pips in the HP box (3+3), and the attack buff and HP buff are both from the respective dice boxes (4+4).

card_dali_s_convoy.name: DALI'S CONVOY
card_dali_s_convoy.rulesText: Enemies must roll two dice instead of one to hit entities in the fortress, and both must hit.
card_dali_s_convoy.notes: The fortress HP is calculated from the pips in the HP box, and the HP buff is from the HP buff box. The special rule is explicitly labeled.

card_desperate_measures.name: DESPERATE MEASURES
card_desperate_measures.miscStat: status: SLIME & GRIME- (subtract 1 ATK from entity)
card_desperate_measures.rulesText: If you're in dire straits, you can eat your cards. Draw a card randomly from your deck & discard it. This recovers +2 HP to max.
card_desperate_measures.notes: The HP buff is based on the effect described, and the attack buff is not applicable as it states a negative effect instead.

card_righteous_indignation_device.name: Righteous indignation DEVICE
card_righteous_indignation_device.rulesText: (If you choose) once during a battle, you and your enemy have 30 seconds to take a photo. The funnier photo wins, and the loser's entity loses -2 HP (loser's choice).
card_righteous_indignation_device.notes: The HP buff is indicated as 0 since it doesn't provide a positive buff, and the attack buff is clearly stated.

card_transhuman_dilemma.name: TRANSHUMAN DILEMMA
card_transhuman_dilemma.rulesText: If you or an ally die in battle, your items transfer to your allies or are sold, instead of being discarded.
card_transhuman_dilemma.notes: The card is consumable as it does not have its own HP or attack and has a special effect.

card_dirt_coffee.name: Dirt Coffee
card_dirt_coffee.rulesText: After your attack roll, you can discard a random card from your deck to recover up to +2 HP.
card_dirt_coffee.notes: The attack buff is negative (-1), indicating a reduction in attack. The HP buff is +2, as stated in the description.

card_mulch_operator.name: MULCH OPERATOR
card_mulch_operator.rulesText: This worm operator can target up to three enemies at once, rolling one die per enemy/fortress being targeted.
card_mulch_operator.notes: The attack value is based on the pips shown in the attack box. The HP is based on the pips in the HP box.

card_doomscroll_dampener.name: DOOMSCROLL DAMPENER
card_doomscroll_dampener.rulesText: While equipped, if your enemy uses their phone at any time during the game, they must discard from their deck. If you use your phone, your entity blows up.
card_doomscroll_dampener.notes: The attack buff and HP buff are based on the visible pips in the respective boxes. The description summarizes the card's effect.

card_mobile_dream_crusher.name: MOBILE DREAM CRUSHER
card_mobile_dream_crusher.rulesText: Instead of an attack roll, you can discard a random card from your deck. Your enemy target automatically loses -1 HP.
card_mobile_dream_crusher.notes: The card is an item with no inherent HP or attack values, but it has a special effect.

card_gerald_eggsly.name: GERALD EGGSLY
card_gerald_eggsly.rulesText: At the end of your combat turn, roll a 3 or below. If you hit, you eat an egg you saved, recovering +1 HP.
card_gerald_eggsly.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the sum of the pips shown on the dice. The special ability is indicated by the yellow header.

card_emotional_nullification_helmet.name: EMOTIONAL NULLIFICATION HELMET
card_emotional_nullification_helmet.rulesText: This device allows you to deal additional damage at the cost of your own health. Each hit removes 2 HP from the enemy, but you lose 1 HP as well.
card_emotional_nullification_helmet.notes: The HP buff is based on the visible pips in the HP buff box.

card_evicted_from_shell.name: EVICTED FROM SHELL
card_evicted_from_shell.rulesText: Play this card at any time. Your enemy must go outside and come back. While they are gone, you can look through their cards and reorganize them any way you want. You may also discard 3 of their cards (your choice).
card_evicted_from_shell.notes: The card is consumable and does not have any special header.

card_foot_oiling_machine.name: FOOT OILING MACHINE
card_foot_oiling_machine.rulesText: This item provides a +1 HP buff and a -1 attack debuff to entities. Any special or consumable attack is nullified if you roll a 1 after your enemy attacks.
card_foot_oiling_machine.notes: The attack buff is negative, indicating a debuff to the enemy's attack. The HP buff is positive, providing a benefit.

card_brick_2_0_1.name: BRICK 2.0
card_brick_2_0_1.rulesText: This item adds 1 HP and 1 attack to an entity when equipped.
card_brick_2_0_1.notes: The card does not have a special header, and it is not a consumable item.

card_freak.name: FREAK
card_freak.notes: The attack value is based on the pips shown in the attack box.

card_phone_with_free_will.name: PHONE WITH FREE WILL
card_phone_with_free_will.rulesText: Once during the game, you can roll a 4 or below to trade places with an enemy. If you roll a 6, this entity dies.
card_phone_with_free_will.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the visible pips on the dice.

card_fubal_boye.name: FUBAL BOYE
card_fubal_boye.rulesText: Throw him at an enemy. He will explode and die. Roll a 4 or below. If you hit, the enemy loses 3 HP.
card_fubal_boye.notes: The attack value is based on the pips shown in the attack box. The HP and attack values are clear from the dice shown.

card_funny_business.name: FUNNY BUSINESS
card_funny_business.rulesText: Set a timer for 60 seconds. You and an enemy must write a joke before the timer ends. The funniest one wins, judged by a third player or an A.I. LLM. The loser's entity dies.
card_funny_business.notes: The card is consumable and does not provide any HP or attack stats.

card_gasoline_powered_phone.name: Gasoline Powered Phone
card_gasoline_powered_phone.rulesText: At the beginning of combat, the first person to call a third person does -1 HP damage to all combat enemies.
card_gasoline_powered_phone.notes: The attack and HP buffs are based on the visible pips in the respective boxes.

card_gat_wit_da_chiz.name: GAT WIT DA CHIZ
card_gat_wit_da_chiz.rulesText: This entity has 2 HP and can attack with a roll of 2 or below.
card_gat_wit_da_chiz.notes: The attack value is based on the roll threshold provided.

card_glove_socks.name: GLOVE SOCKS
card_glove_socks.notes: The card does not have a special header, and it is not a consumable item.

card_gluttonous_bastard.name: GLUTTONOUS BASTARD
card_gluttonous_bastard.rulesText: This entity has 3 HP and can attack with a roll of 3 or below.

card_automated_gnome_armorer.name: Automated Gnome Armorer
card_automated_gnome_armorer.rulesText: At the beginning of a battle, roll a 3 or below. If you hit, draw a random card. If it is an item you can equip, keep it. Otherwise, return it to the deck.
card_automated_gnome_armorer.notes: The attack buff is negative, indicating a reduction in attack. The HP buff adds to an entity's HP, but the card itself does not have HP or attack.

card_gnome_deplacator.name: Gnome Deplacator
card_gnome_deplacator.rulesText: In combat, allies get an additional bonus attack on death.
card_gnome_deplacator.notes: The attack buff is derived from the 'Steely Knife' icon, which indicates a +1 attack bonus.

card_gnome_dynamics_mk_1.name: Gnome Dynamics (MK 1)
card_gnome_dynamics_mk_1.rulesText: If an enemy rolls a 6 against this entity, the log explodes, taking the enemy that killed it with it.
card_gnome_dynamics_mk_1.notes: The HP is calculated from the 4 pips in the HP box, and the attack is from the single pip in the attack box.

card_the_goonmeister.name: THE GOONMEISTER
card_the_goonmeister.rulesText: You can smell him coming from a mile away.
card_the_goonmeister.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the pips shown in the respective boxes.

card_goos_navigator.name: GOOS NAVIGATOR
card_goos_navigator.rulesText: At the end of your combat turn, roll a 3 or below. If you hit, the goose navigates you to the back door of your enemy's fortress, locking them out and allowing you to own the fortress.
card_goos_navigator.notes: The attack value is based on the dice shown, which indicates a roll of 3 or below.

card_goos_faucet.name: GOOS FAUCET
card_goos_faucet.rulesText: All your troops in battle gain +1 HP.
card_goos_faucet.notes: The card is consumable and provides an HP buff, but does not have any special rules or additional stats.

card_g_rfield.name: Görfield
card_g_rfield.rulesText: Don't let him near a plate of spaghetti or he'll ruin his nice, white gloves.
card_g_rfield.notes: The attack value is based on the roll threshold of 3 or below.

card_government_welfare.name: Government Welfare
card_government_welfare.rulesText: Play this card at any time. All enemies must discard one random card from their hand. You draw and play 3 random cards from your deck.
card_government_welfare.notes: The card is consumable and does not provide any HP or attack values.

card_grent.name: GRENT
card_grent.rulesText: This fortress allows entities inside to attack in battle but they cannot leave until the battle is over. The tree can also walk into battle at any time.
card_grent.notes: The fortress HP is calculated from the pips in the HP box, and the HP buff is from the 'BARK+' icon.

card_gunch_s_galleon.name: Gunch's Galleon
card_gunch_s_galleon.rulesText: After your combat turn, roll a 4 or below. On hit, an enemy fortress loses 3 HP. If the enemy fortress survives the battle, all HP returns.
card_gunch_s_galleon.notes: The fortress HP is based on the pips in the HP box. The attack buff is not present, and the HP buff is derived from the HP buff box. The special ability is indicated by the yellow header.

card_hathaniel.name: HATHANIEL
card_hathaniel.rulesText: An unholy hybrid between a hermit crab and a man.
card_hathaniel.notes: HP is calculated from the 3 green pips in the HP box (4+4+4=12). Attack is from the single pip in the attack box. No special abilities or buffs are indicated.

card_heated_shower_in_a_can.name: HEATED SHOWER IN A CAN
card_heated_shower_in_a_can.rulesText: If you roll a 6, the lithium ion battery explodes, injuring you by -1 HP. You must then discard this item.
card_heated_shower_in_a_can.notes: The attack buff is based on the pips shown in the attack buff box, and the HP buff is based on the pips in the HP buff box.

card_hernando_hernandez.name: HERNANDO HERNANDEZ
card_hernando_hernandez.rulesText: He harbors a secret. Hopefully you don't learn it when it's too late.
card_hernando_hernandez.notes: The attack value is based on the roll threshold of 3, which is interpreted as the total pips in the attack box.

card_hobarth.name: HOBARTH
card_hobarth.rulesText: At the end of an attack round, roll a 2 or below. If you hit, you cause an enemy's item to disappear (enemy's choice).
card_hobarth.notes: The attack value is based on the dice shown, which indicates a roll of 3.

card_hotdog_of_torment_despair.name: HOTDOG OF TORMENT & DESPAIR
card_hotdog_of_torment_despair.rulesText: You gain +4 HP, but an ally must lose -1 HP from despair. You can exceed your base HP.
card_hotdog_of_torment_despair.notes: The card is consumable and does not have a special header.

card_humbert.name: HUMBERT
card_humbert.rulesText: The Humbert knows where it is because it knows where it isn't.
card_humbert.notes: The attack value is based on the single pip shown in the attack box.

card_i_m_all_eyes.name: I'M ALL EYES
card_i_m_all_eyes.rulesText: A silly little idiot who keeps kicking due to a small bio-fission reactor where his gallbladder should be.
card_i_m_all_eyes.notes: The attack value is based on the single pip shown in the attack box.

card_imposter_kite.name: IMPOSTER KITE
card_imposter_kite.rulesText: This imposter is pretending to be a kitey kait.
card_imposter_kite.notes: The HP is based on the single pip in the HP box. Attack is not defined for this entity.

card_righteous_indignation.name: Righteous Indignation
card_righteous_indignation.rulesText: This item adds 3 attack to an entity when used.
card_righteous_indignation.notes: The card does not have a special header and does not provide HP or fortress HP.

card_the_inflataculus.name: THE INFLATACULUS
card_the_inflataculus.rulesText: After each attack round, the HP of all your entities in battle increases by +2. If your entities exceed 6 HP (or 12 for super-entities), they explode and die.
card_the_inflataculus.notes: The card provides an HP buff but does not have its own HP or attack values.

card_jeremy_wormfield.name: JEREMY WORMFIELD
card_jeremy_wormfield.rulesText: Instead of a dice attack, you can play a game of speed chess against your enemy. If you win, your enemy loses 5 HP. If they win, you lose 1 HP out of embarrassment.
card_jeremy_wormfield.notes: The attack value is not defined, so it is set to null.

card_la_homme_colier.name: La homme écolier
card_la_homme_colier.rulesText: A library rat that reads books in a school setting. A shining example to follow for everyone.
card_la_homme_colier.notes: The attack value is based on the roll threshold mentioned in the description.

card_the_lawyer_gunga.name: THE LAWYER GUNGA
card_the_lawyer_gunga.rulesText: The Gunga can rewrite the rules of the game. At the end of each round, roll a 5 or below. If successful, propose a new rule. If 2/3 players agree, you will play with the new rule until the end of the game.
card_the_lawyer_gunga.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the pips shown in the respective boxes.

card_lil_ball_boy.name: LIL' BALL BOY
card_lil_ball_boy.rulesText: If you roll a 6, an enemy picks you up and throws you into the discard pile.
card_lil_ball_boy.notes: The HP and attack values are based on the pips shown in the respective boxes.

card_machine_that_does_it_all.name: MACHINE THAT DOES IT ALL
card_machine_that_does_it_all.rulesText: At the end of your combat turn, roll a 2 or below. If you hit, draw a random card from the deck and use/equip it. If the card is an entity/fortress or your entity's inventory is full, return it to the deck.
card_machine_that_does_it_all.notes: The card provides buffs but does not have its own HP or attack values.

card_homunculus_missile.name: HOMUNCULUS MISSILE
card_homunculus_missile.rulesText: You can play this card at any time. Roll a 3 or below to kill that number of enemies. Rolling a 4 or above results in your entity dying.
card_homunculus_missile.notes: The card is consumable and does not have a special header.

card_needle_button_trap.name: NEEDLE BUTTON TRAP
card_needle_button_trap.rulesText: Play this card immediately after anyone's special move to nullify that move. Discard with no impact.
card_needle_button_trap.notes: The card is consumable and has no special header.

card_nuclear_suicide_machine.name: Nuclear Suicide Machine
card_nuclear_suicide_machine.rulesText: Roll a 3 or below. If successful, discard all entities and fortresses in play. If no cards remain, everyone loses.
card_nuclear_suicide_machine.notes: The card is consumable and does not provide any HP or attack values.
